text: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness 是面向 Web 和桌面客户端的 DSH 插件：它把模型回复中的 Markdown 组件标签、表达式和 Mermaid 图表渲染成对话内的交互界面。插件向系统提示注入组件语法与使用指导，提供布局、文本、表格、表单控件、统计卡片和图表；用户调整控件时，相关表达式会在浏览器中即时更新，也可通过按钮把当前参数作为后续消息发送。适合制作比较面板、计算器、数据图表和流程图；无需额外 API 密钥，交互状态按消息保存在浏览器本地。

Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness renders Markdown and Mermaid as interactive DSH chat UI. It provides forms, tables, stats, and charts; controls update browser values and buttons send follow-up messages. Use it for calculators and comparisons. No API key is needed; state stays local.
想让 DSH 的回答里直接出现可操作的计算器和图表。
能不能在聊天中用滑块调整参数并即时看到结果？
我想把一段流程描述变成带主题样式的 Mermaid 流程图。
让模型生成带表单、表格和统计卡片的交互式比较面板。
I want model replies to include interactive calculators and charts directly in chat.
Can I adjust values with sliders and see the related figures update immediately?
Turn a process description into a themed Mermaid diagram in the conversation.
Intelligent UI 的功能「inline-controls」：在 DSH 回复中嵌入滑块、输入框、复选框、单选组和下拉框，并将控件变化传给表达式状态。
Intelligent UI 的功能「charts」：在回复中绘制柱状、折线、面积和饼图；图例可切换系列，悬停可查看类别对应的数值。
Intelligent UI 的功能「mermaid」：将回复里的 Mermaid 代码块渲染为对话内的图表，并按角色与主题显示流程节点。
Intelligent UI 的功能「followup」：通过交互按钮把当前控件状态组合成文本并发送为下一条用户消息。
想把对比方案做成可以切换选项并查看图表的聊天界面。

> **Turn LLM responses into live, interactive mini-apps directly inside DeepSeek Harness.**

@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 🪄 Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness：**Intelligent UI** is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (Desktop & Web UI) inspired by ChatGPT's Intelligent UI and Claude Artifacts. Instead of generating static walls of text, the model writes markdown embedded with interactive component tags, reactive expressions, and beautiful Mermaid diagrams. The chat interface renders them in-place in real time as the response streams in.

---

🎨 Themed Mermaid Diagrams with Rounded Nodes & Semantic Role Colors

@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui README · ✨ Key Features：- ⚡ **Real-Time Interactive Mini-Apps**: Sliders, number inputs, dropdowns, and toggles recompute formulas, statistics, and charts instantly inside your browser—no backend round-trips needed.
- 📊 **Rich UI Component Library**: Over 20 built-in components including KPI tiles (`stat`), bar/line/pie charts (`chart`), responsive layouts (`box`, `row`, `grid`), progress bars, data tables, badges, and segmented controls.
- 🎨 **Beautiful Themed Diagrams**: Automatically transforms ` ```mermaid ` fences into styled diagrams with rounded cards, dark/light theme harmony, and hierarchy-aware typography.
- 🔁 **Bidirectional Interaction**: Action buttons (`GenUI.issueNewTurn(...)`) let you send configured values back to the agent as your next prompt with a single click.
- 🧠 **Context-Aware Triggering**: The model intelligently uses UI only when helpful (e.g., calculations, comparisons, workflows) and answers simple questions in clean plain text.
- 🔒 **Secure by Design**: Expressions execute inside a sandboxed AST interpreter without `eval`, DOM access, or network permissions. Form state stays strictly within your local browser session.
@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 🚀 Installation：Requires **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** or later (Desktop app or `dsh web`).

@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Option 1: Web UI / Desktop App (Easiest)：1. Open DeepSeek Harness.
2. Navigate to **Plugins** → Click **Add plugin**.
3. Enter either package name or repository URL:
   ```
   @rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui
   ```
   or
   ```
   https://github.com/rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui
   ```
4. Click **Install**. The plugin is ready to use immediately without restarting!

section: 🛠️ How It Works (What the Model Writes)

text:
@rakutek/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Supported Components & Syntax：| Category | Available Elements |
|---|---|
| **Layout & Structure** | `<box>`, `<row>`, `<grid>`, `<grid-item>`, `<divider>` |
| **Typography & Data** | `<title>`, `<text>`, `<caption>`, `<label>`, `<badge>`, `<icon>`, `<stat>`, `<progress>` |
| **Tables & Collections**| `<table>`, `<table-row>`, `<table-cell>` |
| **Data Visualization** | `<chart type="bar|line|pie|area" data={...}/>`, Themed Mermaid diagrams |
| **Interactive Controls**| `<slider>`, `<input>`, `<checkbox>`, `<radio-group>`, `<radio>`, `<segmented-control>`, `<select>`, `<button>` |
| **Expressions & Logic** | `{expression}`, `{#if condition}...{/if}`, `{#each item in list}...{/each}`, `{@body ...}` |
